coverage.statement: Returns all registered main families including dependencies, not proof that every costly statistic or experimental solver has been enumerated.

excluded.reason: Manual Git-history snapshot; cost not measured here. CI/page reads reuse it.

artifacts.command: pnpm --filter @cuberoot/stats-build compute <stat-id>; run the complete compute_all.ts, transfer, and load sequence only through .github/workflows/stats.yml

entries.scope: Podium/PR streaks, moving averages, completed solves, round top-three sums and other heavyStatIds extracted from the isolation list.
entries.basis: Imported WCA results; each statistic retains its own scope.
entries.cost: HEAVY_STATS is a memory-isolation classification, NOT a CPU ranking or uniform measured memory threshold. Individual entries have exceptions; comparable CPU measurements are unknown.

update.strategy: compute_all computes selected statistics from the imported dump; stats_filter can restrict IDs. Other builders/imports have separate strategies.

entries.publication: Validated JSON owner patches publish to wca-data-latest/static statistics. Database builders have separate transfer/load steps. Code push only syntax-checks this workflow.

name.zh: WCA 历史排名与纪录演化

artifacts.command: pnpm --filter @cuberoot/stats-build compute <stat-id>; run the complete compute_all.ts, transfer, and load sequence only through .github/workflows/stats.yml

entries.scope: Historical ranking snapshots, historical best SOR, daily SOR evolution and historical WR/CR/NR records.
entries.basis: Historical result replay and time-series snapshots, not only current personal bests.
entries.cost: Large historical result replay/aggregation; no comparable CPU or memory measurement registered.

update.strategy: Full workflow builds rank snapshots; best-rank SOR consumes those TSVs; daily SOR replays competition-day results. Separate wca_results_flat imports use competition fingerprint deltas. Do not label the entire chain incremental.

entries.publication: Historical ranks/best SOR transfer TSV/load SQL into PostgreSQL; daily SOR and record histories publish JSON.

name.zh: 比赛打乱阶段难度与最优步数
name.en: Competition scramble difficulty and optimal lengths

artifacts.command: pnpm --filter @cuberoot/scramble-stats-build build:<target>; build:example-shards only splits existing JSON without solvers; use the matching runbook or skill for the complete heavy pipeline

entries.scope: stages (Cross/XCross and other 3x3 goals), 333opt (whole-cube optimal), puzzles (2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, Clock, SQ1 and selected puzzle jobs).
entries.basis: Competition scramble corpus, not a uniform full-state distribution.
entries.cost: Per-scramble stage/optimal solving, including expensive 3x3/SQ1 searches; no measured cross-job CPU ordering.

update.strategy: Explicit stages/333opt/puzzles entry: incremental fetching, missing-result backfill and checkpoint continuation. Cached/publish-only modes reuse results. Unresolved puzzle states remain marked unresolved and may accompany a partial publication.

entries.publication: Publishing entry loads relevant PG tables, submits the Release and incrementally publishes static shards. Local-only entry does not publish.

name.zh: 精确分布与全状态数据集

entries.scope: Registered exact puzzle/goal histograms, farthest-state witnesses and full-state downloads.
entries.basis: Full-state exact distances with explicit move metric/frame; some distributions derive from existing verified tables.
entries.cost: Depends on enumerated states and method. Small BFS, closed-form counts and reading histograms are NOT automatically heavy. Per-target CPU measurements are not registered here.

update.strategy: Enumerate or reuse verified tables, validate counts/witnesses, then export histograms. Full-state downloads stream separately; summary export does not rerun BFS.

entries.publication: Compact histogram JSON ships with Web code. Large full-state downloads use a separate verified asset/manifest chain.

entries.scope: Trainable LSLL case optimal solutions and lengths; excludes O class.
entries.basis: Minimum HTM over pre/post AUF equivalence, not one display representative.
entries.cost: Batch optimal solving of case AUF images. Owner README historical benchmarks are not a current site-wide CPU ranking.

update.strategy: Batch solving checkpoints by case key; update_lsll exports cases and applies row-manifest differences. --export-only skips loading; --solve explicitly requests solving.

entries.publication: Exported CSV is diffed against the target PG row manifest, then changed rows load into PostgreSQL.

name.zh: 双底 ZBLL 题库与摘要

artifacts.command: pnpm --filter @cuberoot/alg-build double-zbll:export, then pnpm --filter @cuberoot/client double-zbll:install ../.local-data/double-zbll-symmetry-v2/export, then pnpm --filter @cuberoot/client double-zbll:summary

entries.scope: Batch optimal solving, candidate selection and resulting corpus length distributions.
entries.basis: Frozen case/candidate corpus, canonical AUF and explicit selection criteria.
entries.cost: Upstream batch solving is heavy. Summary refresh only aggregates installed corpus data without loading solver tables.

update.strategy: Reuse verified solve journals, export/install the corpus and regenerate its summary when it changes. CI/browser startup does not rerun heavy solving.

entries.publication: Verified hash-named corpus assets/manifest and compact statistics JSON ship through the artifact owner.

artifacts.command: follow the matching solver loop or runbook; use available CPU parallelism by default

entries.scope: Pruning/distance tables supporting statistics; not an ordinary statistical leaderboard.
entries.basis: Solver-specific coordinates, metrics and verified formats.
entries.cost: Some builds require substantial memory/CPU; table size alone is not a CPU measurement.

update.strategy: Generate/verify the table family and reuse it across solves. Ordinary CI/page opening does not rebuild large tables. Metadata reads never start or authorize computation.

entries.publication: Large local tables stay outside Git; runtime artifacts have their own deployment contracts.
